# Agentic Income

Agentic Income helps founders, experts, consultants, creators, and operators turn one valuable workflow into a governed income system they own.

## Main product

The core delivery unit is an Outcome Pack: buyer and problem, accepted outcome, offer and legal principal, agent workflow and interfaces, authority and budgets, evals, economics, runbook, evidence, and failure paths.

The premium commercial offer is a scope-first Revenue System Implementation Sprint. Open-source skills, a Request-to-Quote reference system, templates, and self-serve products expose the method at lower commitment.

## Authority model

Agents may research, triage, draft, build, test, and prepare evidence. An authorized human or legal entity remains the principal, account owner, payee, and final authority for pricing, contracts, credentials, customer-facing sends, production promotion, public income claims, and movement of money.

No income promises. Reference systems are not customer evidence or legal, financial, or tax advice.

## Research policy

Editorial and affiliate research is a distribution layer, not the main product. Recommendations must show criteria, evidence date, tradeoffs, unpaid alternatives, and any material incentive. Program terms can change; verify current terms at the provider before relying on a payout or availability claim.

## Network

- Agentic Income: active work, offers, Outcome Packs, and principal-owned agent services.
- Agentic Passive Income: inspectable automated loops and recurring operating systems.
- Disruptive Passive Income: compounding and wealth-system research.
